fit_umap_on_worker_gpu: fit a UMAP dimensionality reduction model on GPU using Ray and cuML with cosine metric
fit_hdbscan_on_worker_gpu: fit an HDBSCAN clustering model on GPU using Ray and cuML with configurable min cluster size
fit_kmeans_on_worker_gpu: fit a KMeans clustering model on GPU using Ray and cuML with configurable number of clusters
SentenceEmbedder: create a Ray actor that embeds text batches using a SentenceTransformer model on GPU
LLMEmbedder: create a Ray actor that embeds text batches using a HuggingFace transformer model on GPU
UmapTransformer: create a Ray actor that transforms embeddings into low-dimensional UMAP space using a pre-fitted cuML model
CumlClusteringPredictor: create a Ray actor that predicts cluster labels for embeddings using a pre-fitted HDBSCAN or KMeans model
get_outputs_path: generate all artifact file paths for a clustering run including embeddings, UMAP models, and cluster results
save_model: save a Python model object to disk using cloudpickle with directory creation and error logging
load_model: load a Python model object from a cloudpickle file with error handling and logging
xxhash128: compute a 128-bit xxHash digest of a text string and return it as a hex string
is_valid_parquet: check if a directory contains at least one readable Parquet file
is_valid_pickle: check if a file exists and contains valid pickle data that can be loaded
pandas_join: perform an inner join between two Ray Datasets using a sampled subset and Pandas merge
summarize_clustering_stats: calculate and log cluster statistics including total points, cluster counts, and size percentiles from a Ray Dataset
inner_join: perform an inner join between two Ray Datasets using groupby with pickle serialization for complex column types
inner_join_basic_types: perform an inner join between two Ray Datasets using groupby for datasets with only basic column types
